messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — Private KMS proxy errors causing 502s for Private deployments in eu-west and apac. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1832100000

sara (oncall): Putting initial summary here. Impact: model load failures and inference 502s for customers using Private (VPC) deployments with external KMS. Not platform-wide, mostly eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1.

mike (eng-sre): Observed spike in `keywrap` errors from edge-kms-router after a config roll that started ~00:58 UTC. Error sample: `kms: token refresh failed, upstream 503`.

rob (platform): Rolling back the config now (edge-kms-router) and scaling replicas. Started `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/edge-kms-router` -> in progress.

sara (oncall): Mitigations in-flight: 1) rollback config 2) scale to 6 replicas 3) enable local KMS cache bypass for reads. ETA for observable recovery ~15-30m. I'll update when metrics show improvement.

alina (customer-success): Heads-up: 8 enterprise customers in affected regions. CSMs notified and on standby for calls. Drafted short status note to send to impacted customers after we confirm mitigation.

mike (eng-sre): Quick note on root cause hypothesis: a config value for token TTL was accidentally set to 0 on the router, triggering immediate refresh storms and an upstream throttling cascade. Will confirm with logs.

kate (product): Thanks — can you add a pointer for customers about temporary rate limits and recommended retry behavior? I'll coordinate messaging.

nina (legal): Please ensure any logs we pull for customers are redacted of key_material and secrets before sharing externally.

rob (platform): Rollback completed at +7m. Scaling completed at +9m. Observing decreased error rate on health checks.

incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE — partial recovery: 72% of Private KMS operations now succeeding. Continued monitoring. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1832100000/updates

sara (oncall): Current status: partial mitigation, customer impact reduced but a small fraction still seeing intermittent 5xx. Oncall will remain engaged until fully recovered. Postmortem owners: mike + rob.

mike (eng-sre): Commands used during mitigation:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/edge-kms-router
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/edge-kms-router --replicas=6
# enabled local cache bypass via feature flag: router.local_cache_bypass=true
```

alina (customer-success): Sent interim note to impacted customers with link to status page and ETA. Will update as soon as we hit full recovery.

kate (product): Exec note queued for EOD summarizing impact, customer list, and credits.

nina (legal): Acknowledged — will review any external comms for compliance.

sara (oncall): Next steps: full verification of token TTL validation in CI, add guard to config push flow, postmortem in #postmortems within 48h. Assigning action owners in the postmortem doc.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED — monitoring. If you see new customer reports, please add them to the incident thread. :thumbsup:
